node.title: Re: regex for nested "<"/">'
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
In the regex, changing \d*+ to \d++ fixes it, although I have to admit I don't see why yet, it'll take a bit more staring at it to figure that out... Anyway: [https://webperl.zero-g.net/regex.html#flags=x®ex=(%3F%26LIST)%0A(%3F(DEFINE)%0A%20%20(%3F%3CLIST%3E%20%3C%20(%3F%26ITEM)%20%20(%3F%3A%20%2C%20(%3F%26ITEM)%20)*%2B%20%3E%20)%0A%20%20(%3F%3CITEM%3E%20%5Cd%2B%2B%20%7C%20(%3F%26LIST)%20)%0A)&samp1=%3C1%3E&samp2=%3C1%2C2%3E&samp3=%3C1%2C2%2C%3C3%2C4%3E%2C5%2C6%3E|WebPerl Regex Tester Link]

Personally, I'd use [mod://Regexp::Common] for this kind of task:

use warnings; use strict; use Regexp::Common 2013030901 qw/balanced/; my $re = qr/$RE{balanced}{-parens=>'<>'}/; print $re, "\n"; my @cases = ( "<1>" ,"<1,2>" ,"<1,2,<3,4>,5,6>" ); for my $case (@cases) { print $case, " ", $case =~ $re ? "matches: '$1'\n" : "doesn't match\n"; } __END__ (?^:((?:\<(?:(?>[^\<\>]+)|(?-1))*\>))) <1> matches: '<1>' <1,2> matches: '<1,2>' <1,2,<3,4>,5,6> matches: '<1,2,<3,4>,5,6>'
